text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. emerged victorious in the 
Takarazuka Kinen. After the race, 
Katsuragi Ace roared a challenge at her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Even if God says she'll lose, she will 
become strong enough to silence fate and 
win. Mr. C.B. felt her heart burn with 
excitement."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. requested a GⅠ for her next race. 
She decided to set her sights on the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn), where Katsuragi Ace was also 
likely to run.
